meta_description: Work with the Geneva Solution Space: become a partner, rent a desk in our 7th-floor co-working space, or book the space for your event.

hero.title: Work with us
hero.lede: International NGOs, associations, start-ups and University of Geneva teams all have a place here — as partners with a desk, as hosts of an event, or as collaborators on our programmes.

paths.title: Become a partner
paths.text: Join the ecosystem of organizations working on human development and sustainability at Campus Biotech.

paths.title: Rent a desk
paths.text: A desk on the 7th floor of Campus Biotech Innovation Park, with meeting rooms next door.

paths.title: Book the space
paths.text: Host a class, workshop, hackathon or conference on the ground floor or in the Fab Lab.

partner.title: Become
partner.lede: If you are an international NGO, association or start-up working in the areas of human development and sustainability, we would love to hear from you. Partners rent desks in our co-working space and take part in the life of the ecosystem.

steps.text: Tell us who you are, what you work on and what you are looking for — a desk, a venue, or a project to collaborate on.
Come and meet the team at Campus Biotech Innovation Park and see the desks, meeting rooms and ground floor.
Agree a desk for a year, renewable, and start using the meeting rooms, the space and the Geneva address.

band.title: Just need
band.text: You don't need to be a partner to use the space. Anyone can request the ground floor or the Fab Lab for an event.
